mapper.select: /* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.getOwnerStoreId SQL 명: 사장님 가게 ID 조회 */ SELECT id FROM tb_store WHERE owner_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

/* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.getOwnerStore SQL 명: 사장님 가게 정보와 오늘 주문·매출 현황 */ SELECT s.id AS store_id , s.name , s.category , s.address , s.phone , (SELECT i.image_url FROM tb_store_image i WHERE i.store_id = s.id ORDER BY i.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS image_url , s.status , s.delivery_time AS wait_minutes , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order o WHERE o.store_id = s.id AND o.created_datetime >= CURDATE() AND o.status != 'CANCELLED') AS today_order_count , (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) FROM tb_order o WHERE o.store_id = s.id AND o.created_datetime >= CURDATE() AND o.status = 'DELIVERED') AS today_sales , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order o WHERE o.store_id = s.id AND o.status = 'PENDING') AS new_order_count , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order o WHERE o.store_id = s.id AND o.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'PREPARING', 'DELIVERING')) AS in_progress_order_count FROM tb_store s WHERE s.id = #{storeId}
mapper.sql: SELECT o.order_id , o.status , o.order_type , o.total_amount , o.payment_method , o.delivery_phone AS contact_phone , o.order_request , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(m.name, ' x', oi.quantity) ORDER BY oi.order_item_id SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tb_order_items oi JOIN tb_menus m ON m.id = oi.menu_id WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id) AS item_summary , (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) FROM tb_order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id) AS item_count , o.created_datetime AS ordered_at FROM tb_order o
mapper.select: /* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.getOwnerOrderCount SQL 명: 사장님 가게 주문 수 */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order o WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId}

/* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.owner.dao.OwnerDao.getOwnerMenuList SQL 명: 사장님 가게 메뉴 목록 */ SELECT m.id AS menu_id , c.name AS category_name , m.name , m.price , m.image_url , m.is_sold_out FROM tb_menus m LEFT JOIN tb_menu_category c ON c.id = m.category_id WHERE m.store_id = #{storeId} AND m.is_active = 1 ORDER BY c.sort_order, m.sort_order, m.id
